SqliteConnectionLifetimeTests.test_produ.obsolete: It scanned production code for `with sqlite3.connect(...)` blocks, which commit but never close the connection. No production module opens a sqlite3 connection any more; PostgreSQL connections are borrowed from the pool and returned by backend.db's library_command/library_query scopes (tests/pg/test_db_transactions.py).

SqliteConnectionLifetimeTests.test_resea.note: The SQLite research index was a second database file with its own connection scope; on PostgreSQL the Research index is tables of the Library database, reached through the same pooled transaction helpers.

SqliteConnectionLifetimeTests.test_tests.obsolete: It scanned test code for transaction-only `with db.get_connection()` blocks on PRKSDatabase, which is deleted with SQLite; PostgreSQL tests use the harness and backend.db's scoped helpers, which always return the connection to the pool.

SqliteConnectionLifetimeTests.test_text_.note: The SQLite text index was a second database file with its own connection scope; on PostgreSQL the text index is tables of the Library database, reached through the same pooled transaction helpers.
